body: The pair is streaked with marked feed sack from treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished, before anyone marked the counter unsafe.
title: Marked feed sack by the counter
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body: The glass was rinsed but the strip of tape stays on it, marked to be kept after closing. The cloth is stiff with bleach. Someone expected the counter to be cleaned before the glass was taken away.
title: The glass nobody collected
gloss: A glass is retained after a hurried cleaning of the counter.
rival_reading: An ordinary sanitation check after spoiled supplies could account for the tape and bleach.
